{{Top|leg}}
The '''North Conical Mountains''' were an arrangement of seven cones&mdash;six small cones surrounding a large, center cone &mdash; situated at one end of [[Centerpoint Station]]'s [[Hollowtown]]. It was believed that this unusual geometric array of cones generated the power needed to operate the powerful [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] of [[Centerpoint Station]], as it resembled ancient devices of a similar nature. The largest cone was often referred to as the '''North Conical Mountain'''.
